summary: Phishing Simulator end-to-end test (backend pytest 37/38 + Playwright UI as free student and admin). Sidebar nav, 14-type grid, free note, type detail (MITRE/how/red flags/defences/example), case gating (3 free, rest locked + 403), all 14 starter cases render (QR image + decode link, wifi table), ph-email-1 scoring (100% with refanged/hxxps IOCs, +40 XP once, wrong-pick penalty, retry reset), OSINT toolkit (reputation via intel + ?value deep link, expand + bit.ly trace + SSRF block for 169.254/127/localhost/10.x, header analyzer auth badges/warnings/hops/IOC chips filling reputation, QR ?qr= auto-decode + file upload + Trace, lookalike paypal.com -> 40 registered), Manage tab (AI generation of 1 case finished in ~15s, preview, publish toggle -> appears with sparkle for admin and locked for student, unpublish hides it, delete, 403 for non-staff) all work. Issues: locked-case link /pricing is a non-existent route (redirects to landing), IOC prefix matching double-counts, minor UI nits.

minor.issue: IOC prefix matching (norm(i).startswith(g) / g.startswith(norm(i))) over-credits: entering only 'micros0ft-securemail.com' hits both the domain AND the full URL IOC -> 10/20 instead of 5/20. Also '185.234.219.123' would match '185.234.219.12'. Use exact normalized match (plus maybe URL==URL ignoring trailing slash/scheme) instead of startswith.
SSRF check resolves DNS in safe_target() but httpx resolves again when connecting -> DNS-rebinding TOCTOU. Consider connecting to the vetted IP (or a custom transport) to close the gap.
XP 'first pass' check is read-then-insert (not atomic); concurrent double-submits could award XP twice. Low risk.
Unauthenticated public QR generator (max 600 chars). Acceptable but could be abused as an open QR service; consider auth or rate limit.

ui_bugs.issue: Links to '/pricing' but App.js has no /pricing route -> catch-all Navigate to '/' (landing). Paid upsell is broken. Use '/app/billing' (existing route) or '/#pricing'.
Toast 'This case is for paid members' shows twice (effect runs twice in StrictMode/dev) before redirect to /app/phishing. Cosmetic.
Student opening /app/phishing?tab=manage gets an empty page (no tab content, no grid). Fall back to learn tab.

design_issues.screen: Evil Twin case wifi panel (Panels.jsx WifiP)
issues: WifiP renders <Table p={{title:''}}> which renders a second, empty Head bar (just a radar icon) under the Wi-Fi header. Render the table body without Head.
'Look up' and 'Find lookalikes' buttons wrap onto 2 lines at 1920px (add whitespace-nowrap/shrink-0).
Types data is fetched once on mount; after publishing in Manage tab and switching to Learn, list is stale until reload (minor).

action_items: Fix '/pricing' links in Phishing.jsx (CaseRow locked + free-note upgrade) -> route that exists (e.g. /app/billing or /#pricing)
Tighten IOC matching in routes_phish.submit to avoid one IOC counting for several (domain vs URL prefix, IP prefix)
Remove empty header in WifiP panel; add whitespace-nowrap to OSINT run buttons
Optional: fallback to learn tab for non-staff ?tab=manage; dedupe locked-case toast; harden expand against DNS rebinding
critical_code_review_comments: routes_phish.py submit(): startswith-based IOC fuzzy match is too lenient (see minor issue).
routes_phish.py expand(): resolve-then-connect TOCTOU for SSRF protection.
list_types always calls all_cases() (published only) even for staff — fine, drafts are previewed via Manage, but staff can't see drafts on type pages (intended?).
Files sizes OK (<430 lines); data-testids present on all key elements.

Side effects on seeded accounts: student and admin now have phish_attempts for ph-email-1 and received +40 XP for passing it (expected behaviour of the feature, but note student/admin XP changed).

Admin login redirects to /admin (wait for **/admin**), student to /app. Red-flag/response options mapped by text. bit.ly/3IndPst returns 404 from bit.ly (single hop) — tracer works but that sample link is dead. AI generation took ~15s.
rca of the issue: /pricing: App.js defines only '/' (Landing with #pricing anchor) and /app/billing; Phishing.jsx hard-codes '/pricing', so the '*' route redirects to '/'. IOC over-credit: hits list comprehension counts an expected IOC as hit if any given value is a >6-char prefix of it, so a bare domain matches the URL IOC that starts with it.
